title: Chiswick Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in Chiswick.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Charing Cross Hospital (Fulham Palace Road, Hammersmith W6 8RF) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Turnham Green station: ~2 miles east; ~35 min walk east along Chiswick High Road and King Street, or take bus 190 or 27 east (~15 mins). West Middlesex University Hospital (Twickenham Road, Isleworth TW7 6AF) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Gunnersbury station: ~3.5 miles west; take bus 237 or 267 west along London Road (~25 mins). Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St Mary's Hospital (Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: Charing Cross Urgent Treatment Centre (Fulham Palace Road W6 8RF, co-located at hospital) — open 24 hours daily for urgent minor injuries and illness. Hammersmith Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre (Du Cane Road, White City W12 0HS) — open daily 8am to midnight (no A&E on that site). 3. Local Hazard Notes: The tidal River Thames forms the southern boundary; tidal surges and exceptionally high spring tides cause localized flooding along Chiswick Mall, Strand-on-the-Green, and riverside towpaths. 4. Supplies: Chiswick High Road and Turnham Green Terrace provide numerous retail pharmacies and grocery stores stocking essential first aid, hygiene goods, and drinking water. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
